Grant Title: Innovations in Low-Cost and Simplified Pathogen Sequencing Workflows
Grant Description: A Grand Challenge co-funded by the Gates Foundation and Temasek Foundation, managed by the United Nations Foundation. This RFP aims to accelerate development of affordable, scalable, and operationally simple sequencing solutions for routine public health use in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). The initiative seeks to lower total sample-to-sequence costs to approximately US$1–10 per sample while addressing priority pathogens including viruses (polio, measles, arboviruses, mpox), malaria, tuberculosis, and bacterial/microbial pathogens. Proposals must demonstrate credible pathways to cost reduction through workflow simplification, platform compatibility, reduced turnaround time, and proof-of-concept validation. Funding is tiered to support projects at different stages of technical maturity, from early-stage feasibility to advanced development and validation in LMIC public-health laboratory settings.

Grant Title: Urban Water Program
Grant Description: The grant enables individuals and organizations to address water and sanitation issues in their neighborhoods or any specific geography in Bengaluru and its peri-urban areas. The program will support the design and implementation of an idea over a year. It focuses on issues such as sewage management, stormwater drain maintenance, groundwater table monitoring, lake maintenance, and wastewater treatment and reuse. Eligible projects include rainwater harvesting, community groundwater recharge, water-health correlation studies, prevention of sewage and stormwater mixing, STP maintenance protocols, wastewater reuse solutions, and pollution control in water bodies.

The platform must be interoperable with Cameroon's national eHealth architecture in collaboration with the Ministry of Public Health (MINSANTE) and the Directorate of Healthcare Organization and Health Technology (DOSTS).

Request for quotations for construction of an access road for liquid oxygen tank supply route in Mozambique
Grant Description: CHAI is soliciting quotations for the construction of an access road to enable safe, continuous circulation and maneuvering of tanker trucks supplying the Liquid Oxygen (LOX) tank installed at Hospital Geral de Nampula (HGN), Natiquiri District, Nampula Province, Mozambique. This work is part of CHAI's ongoing support, in partnership with GLOBAL FUND, to strengthen Mozambique's national medical oxygen ecosystem, including the supply and installation of Vacuum Insulated Evaporator (VIE)/LOX tanks and ambient vaporizers, and related testing, commissioning, and civil works.

Grant Title: Research for Strengthening and Enhancing Quality of Medical Education
AI-Enabled Consumer Engagement to Advance Family Planning
Grant Description: This RFP seeks to generate evidence on whether AI-enabled direct-to-consumer engagement can improve contraceptive uptake, continuation, and informed method choice at scale in sub-Saharan Africa. The challenge aims to identify which AI-enabled engagement approaches (e.g., content personalization, rapid content scaling, automated customer journeys) work best for which user types. Applicants must deploy, test, and evaluate AI-enabled consumer engagement tools in family planning or related women's health contexts. Successful proposals must demonstrate credible evaluation designs, contribute to a shared evidence base (including labeled interaction examples, quality rubrics, taxonomies, and guardrail protocols), and operate at sufficient scale to generate meaningful findings within the grant period. Target geographies include Nigeria, Ethiopia, DRC, Tanzania, Senegal, Niger, Kenya, South Africa, Zambia, and Côte d'Ivoire.

Grant Title: Multiplex Platforms to Assess Indicators of Micronutrient Status, Inflammation and Infectious Disease
Grant Description: This Grand Challenge seeks novel approaches to develop multiplex platforms for assessing indicators of micronutrient status, inflammation, and infectious disease. Applicants should develop improved multiplex assays to measure multiple micronutrient biomarkers simultaneously. Two alternatives are offered: Alternative A (minimum scope, up to $200,000, 12 months) focuses on strengthening and modestly extending current multiplex tests; Alternative B (optimistic scope, up to $800,000, 24 months) extends the panel further to include biomarkers for additional vitamins and thyroid hormones. Both alternatives must achieve high analytical specificity, sensitivity, and robustness while maintaining low cost (≤$20 per sample) and using small sample volumes.

Grant Title: Call for funding Clinical Trials by functional Clinical Trials Units under ICMR-Intramural Research Program (Revised)
Request for proposals for a real-time gas monitoring system for LOX in Mozambique
Grant Description: CHAI is issuing a Request for Proposals (RFP) to solicit priced offers for the supply, installation, integration and cloud-based monitoring of telemetry equipment as part of the Real-Time Gas Monitoring System (RTGMS) for Mozambique's national Liquid Oxygen (LOX) network. Mozambique's oxygen infrastructure has been strengthened through VIE tank installations across 27 health facilities, but lacks a unified real-time monitoring system. A Phase 1 baseline assessment identified 27 tanks without telemetry hardware and 15 tanks with hardware but no data transmission or power. The RFP seeks a brand-agnostic, cloud-based RTGMS solution capable of addressing both situations and scaling to remaining tanks in the 42-tank national network.

Grant Title: Invitation for bid: implementation and technical support of health resource tracking solution in Ethiopia
Grant Description: Request for Proposal from Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI) for development of a locally led hybrid delivery model using modular, standards-based Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) for health resource tracking (HRT) in Ethiopia. The HRT initiative aims to improve visibility, accountability, and efficiency in financial resource use by integrating multiple financial, health, procurement, and partner systems. Key deliverables include establishing interoperable data exchange across in-scope systems, enhancing IBEX workflows for Channel 2 resource tracking, defining master data registries and operational reference structures, configuring and validating data exchange layers (iFIX), delivering role-based dashboards for MoH, MoF, and regions, conducting technical assessments of in-scope systems, and producing complete technical documentation, source code, training and operational materials.

Grant Title: Systemic Education Reform Program

The program provides financial grants, capacity building opportunities, mentoring support, and partner network access to three categories of organizations: early and mid-stage organizations working in school education, community-based organizations with a desire to enter school education, and established organizations from other sectors seeking to bring their expertise into education.

Grant Title: Request for proposals for web and digital support for the Global Oxygen Alliance's (GO2AL) Secretariat

The vendor will lead migration of the site to a new hosting environment, provide continuous hosting, security, and maintenance over a two-year period, and deliver on-demand development support—including data integration, dashboards, and training—for the GO2AL Secretariat.

CHAI is leading this initiative in partnership with Concept Foundation, Aurum Institute, Burnet Institute, and WACI Health. The RFP accepts proposals from manufacturers of ferric carboxymaltose (FCM), an intravenous iron product clinically proven as a safe and effective treatment for pregnant women with anemia. Selected manufacturers may receive technical assistance and/or financial support to accelerate development, approval, and supply.
